Ram Temple Donation Row: Officials Resign Amid Embezzlement Probe

An investigation into alleged embezzlement of donations at the Ram temple in Ayodhya has led to key officials offering to resign. A Special Investigation Team (SIT) reportedly found Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) violations and evidence of fraud. The controversy has sparked political debate, with opposition leaders criticizing the government and temple trust.
